raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "geoarrow-pyarrow" %}
{% set version = "0.2.0" %}


package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name | replace('-', '_') }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 5c981f5cae26fa6cdfb6f9b83fb490d36bf0fe6f6fa360c4c8983e0a8a457926

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-build-isolation --no-deps

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - setuptools >=61.0.0
    - setuptools-scm
  run:
    - geoarrow-c >=0.3.0
    - geoarrow-types >=0.3.0
    - pyarrow
    - python >={{ python_min }}

test:
  imports:
    - geoarrow.pyarrow
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://github.com/geoarrow/geoarrow-python
  summary: GeoArrow integration with pyarrow and pyarrow-based libraries
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - paleolimbot
